# 打印错误码 / Print error codes · 07

[返回索引 / Index](../../PRINT-ERROR-CODES.md) | [故障码说明 / Guide](../../ERROR-CODES.md)

同码可能因机型不同而有不同文案。来源和原始变体见 `docs/data/error-codes.json`。 Model-specific descriptions and source variants are preserved in that data file.

| `0x07004001` | 检测到禁用AMS时仍从AMS加载料，请将耗材退回AMS并从料盘支架加载新料后重新发起打印。 | The AMS has been disabled for a print, but it still has filament loaded. Please unload the AMS filament and switch to the spool holder filament for printing. |
| `0x07004025` | 读取耗材信息失败。 | Failed to read the filament information. |
| `0x07008001` | 检测到切料失败，请检查切刀。 | Failed to cut the filament. Please check the cutter. |

| `0x07008003` | 耗材退出挤出机失败，可能堵头或耗材卡在挤出机内部。 | Failed to pull out the filament from the extruder. This might be caused by clogged extruder or filament broken inside the extruder. |
| `0x07008004` | 耗材从工具头退回AMS失败。可能是因为料盘卡住，或者耗材的端头卡在路径中。 | AMS failed to pull back filament. This could be due to a stuck spool or the end of the filament being stuck in the path. |
| `0x07008005` | 耗材送出AMS失败。请取出耗材后，剪平料头重新插入。如果异常继续，请检查AMS内部特氟龙管有无磨损。 | The AMS failed to send out filament. You can clip the end of your filament flat, and reinsert. If this message persists, please check the PTFE tubes in AMS for any signs of wear and tear. |
| `0x07008006` | 耗材送往挤出机失败，可能是耗材缠料、料盘卡住、以及AMS特氟龙管未接上。 | Unable to feed filament into the extruder. This could be due to an entangled filament or a stuck spool. If not, please check if the AMS PTFE tube is connected. |
